product_metadata.title: Twin Size Waterproof Cooling Mattress Protector by Slumberfy - Premium Skin-Safe Mattress Cover, Natural Fabric with ArcticTex Cooling Technology, Noiseless Quilted Mattress Protector – 39x75 in.
features: COOLING MATTRESS PROTECTOR Slumberfy has developed developed a hypoallergenic Cooling Mattress Protector, using ArcticTex Cooling Technology to pull heat away from the body and create the perfect sleeping environment. The high-end fabric cools as body temperatures change during the night, for a comfortable sleep all night long.

WATERPROOF MATTRESS PROTECTOR Let’s face it, life happens! Spills, dirt and other liquids can sometimes fall on our bed. But thanks to the innovative micro-coating under the protector’s top layer, they won’t get in your mattress. Our hypoallergenic mattress cover is completely silent, with none of the crinkling sounds you get with a typical mattress protector. Enjoy a sleep experience you simply cannot get anywhere else.

HYPOALLERGENIC MATTRESS PROTECTOR Slumberfy's dust resistant Mattress Protector is tightly woven to ensure that dirt and dust cannot penetrate the mighty (but soft) barrier. Using a unique breathable weave, our hypoallergenic mattress cover is designed to repel dirt, dust and other harmful allergens so you sleep well and your mattress stays fresh and clean. Less dust in your mattress equals a better night’s sleep, every time!

FEATURES & BENEFITS Slumberfy’s allergen blocking Mattress Protector is a fitted sheet style, with ultra-flexible pockets that stretch to fit mattresses up to 18” deep. Cooling Mattress Protector is available in the following sizes: Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King and Cal King.

LIFETIME WARRANTY At Slumberfy, we strive to provide a clean, healthy and comfortable sleep environment. We believe a healthy family starts with a healthy sleep. Slumberfy pledges to help you keep your family’s mattresses safe and protected for a wonderful night’s sleep filled with sweet dreams. We’re so sure you’ll love our products, we offer a Lifetime Warranty!
